title: PharmaOps Copilot — Evidence-First Industrial Agent
description: A local-first prototype for pharma batch-deviation triage. It contextualizes siloed plant exports into one model, then answers from a deterministic evidence packet. Synthetic Batch B-104 only. Not a validated GxP application.
features: Resolves siloed MES, historian, CMMS, QMS, and engineering exports into one operational model, with a reviewable join report for identity, units, and clocks
Evidence-first agent: deterministic tools and hybrid retrieval assemble citations before GPT-4, Claude, or Gemini write an optional narrative
21/21 evals, including jailbreak and prompt-injection refusal, with release and safety decisions left to a human reviewer
Same tools can be served through an MCP-shaped interface and exported as agent configuration, so the workflow is not locked to one demo UI
Build notes on identity matching, units and clocks, policy guardrails, and evals as code

title: Seller Ops Copilot
description: A neighborhood-aware seller insights app that answers plain-English operating questions with GPT-4o tool calling, deterministic business metrics, schema validation, and traceable recommendations.
features: Plain-English Q&A for sales, inventory, staffing, weather, events, and neighborhood context
Typed tool-calling pipeline that computes metrics from JSON data instead of hallucinating numbers
Zod-validated structured outputs with required sources and assumptions surfaced in the UI
Context-gated neighborhood signals, max-round circuit breaker, low-temperature responses, and trace IDs for debugging
17/17 evaluation suite covering tool use, schema compliance, context gating, source fidelity, and recommendation quality

title: ResumeBuilder
description: A LaTeX-first resume and cover-letter system for AI coding agents that tailors content per job while keeping formatting locked, ATS-safe, truthful, and one page.
features: Locked LaTeX style layer separates visual formatting from editable resume content
Agent playbooks, fact bank, role personas, QA checklists, and approval-first prompts prevent invented claims
Per-job application folders generate tailored resume and cover-letter PDFs without changing the canonical baseline
Build scripts compile the canonical resume and application-specific PDFs from source-controlled templates
Documentation-driven workflow maps job descriptions to verified proof points before PDF generation

title: AI Content Detector for Chrome
description: A privacy-first Chrome MV3 extension that scans visible images and selected text for AI-generation signals using local browser inference by default, with optional BYO-key boost providers.
features: Toolbar flow scans visible images and overlays AI/Real badges with confidence scores
Context-menu flow analyzes selected text and highlights likely AI passages
Local mode runs quantized ONNX models in an MV3 offscreen document with no backend or accounts
Optional boost mode calls user-configured Gemini, OpenAI, or Hugging Face providers directly from the browser
Dedicated product website and docs hub cover architecture, roadmap, contribution flow, and privacy model

title: SnapOut
description: An iPhone-first utility for importing official Snapchat Memories exports into Apple Photos while preserving dates and locations when possible, handling duplicates, and keeping all processing on-device.
features: Imports official Snapchat ZIP exports or extracted export folders into Apple Photos
Restores capture dates and locations where export metadata supports it
Creates a single master Snapchat Memories album for organized review
Checks duplicates against the full Photos library without automatic destructive deletion
No Snapchat login, backend, cloud processing, or media upload required

title: Ads Integration Workbench (Android)
description: A production-style Android workbench for testing, debugging, and validating ad network integrations with plugin-driven architecture, observability, and local telemetry analysis.
features: Extensible plugin model for Mock, AdMob, Unity Ads, and AppLovin MAX integrations
Integrations, Actions, Debug Console, and Insights tabs mirror real integration-debug workflows
Structured Room-backed event timeline with filters, deep event inspection, and local telemetry summaries
Debug bundle export captures events, app config, device info, recent errors, and redacted plugin credentials
Issue reproduction harness supports timeout guards, retry policy, bad config injection, offline guard, consent state, and simulated failures

title: Dino Runner Kotlin
description: A Chrome Dino-style endless runner built around a pure, deterministic Kotlin game engine and clean Android architecture for reliable gameplay and high testability.
features: Pure Kotlin core engine has zero Android imports, making game logic portable and unit testable
Seeded random sources and injectable timing create reproducible obstacle patterns and deterministic tests
MVVM and clean architecture separate UI, domain, data, engine, repositories, audio, and haptics concerns
Gameplay systems include jumping physics, collisions, progressive speed, pause/resume, settings, and persisted high score
Quality gates cover unit tests, ktlint, detekt, assembleDebug, and GitHub Actions CI

title: Personal Resume Website (Eleventy)
description: A content-driven personal site built on Eleventy with reusable Nunjucks layouts, structured data files, blog/docs pages, and Netlify deployment.
features: Layout inheritance with shared base templates for maintainability
Data-driven home-page sections sourced from structured JSON files
Blog system with date formatting, tags, excerpts, and feed support
Standalone docs and content pages integrated into the same static build pipeline
Netlify deployment workflow with a production Eleventy build output
